title: Part 1 — Hometown and Daily Routine
promptText: In this part, the examiner asks a few short questions about familiar topics — yourself, your home, your work or studies, and your daily life. Answer naturally in 1-3 sentences each; you don't need to prepare in advance.
followUpQuestions: Can you tell me a little about the town or city where you live?
What do you usually do on a typical weekday?
Do you prefer spending time at home or going out? Why?
Has your hometown changed much in recent years?
modelAnswer:
I live in a mid-sized city on the coast, so it's known mostly for its fishing port and a few old colonial buildings in the centre. It's not huge, but it has everything I need — a university, a couple of malls, and a river that runs right through the middle of town, which is nice to walk along in the evening.

On a typical weekday I get up around six, have a quick breakfast, and then either go to work or, if I'm studying, log into my morning class. Most of my day is spent at a desk, to be honest, so I try to take a short walk at lunchtime just to get some fresh air. In the evening I usually cook something simple, watch a bit of TV, and read before bed.

Honestly, it depends on my mood. On weekdays I'm usually too tired to go out, so I stay home and relax. But on weekends I like meeting friends for coffee or trying a new restaurant — staying in all the time gets a bit dull after a while.

Actually, yes, quite a lot. When I was a child there was a lot of open land near my house, but most of it has been built over now — there's a shopping centre and some new apartment blocks there instead. The traffic has also gotten noticeably worse over the last ten years.
checklistItems: Saya menjawab setiap pertanyaan secara langsung tanpa berhenti lama untuk mencari kata
Saya memberi sedikit detail tambahan di setiap jawaban, bukan hanya satu kata atau satu kalimat pendek
Saya memakai variasi kosakata sehari-hari yang sesuai topik, bukan mengulang kata yang sama terus-menerus
Saya memakai beberapa bentuk waktu (tense) yang berbeda dengan benar sesuai konteks pertanyaan
